category_title: Dominant students with high levels of physical and verbal aggression
scenario_title: Reactive aggression during collaborative science discussion
minimal_context: The student is in a small collaborative group in science class discussing animal welfare after watching a documentary.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that we have finished watching the documentary, please discuss what you saw with your group and share your opinions on how the animals were treated.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I was furious watching that movie. They showed dogs that were thrown to a kind of bin, alive and dead.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit down quietly and write your group's answers on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Glares at a peer) Don't tell me what to write! If you say something to me I'm going to hit you hard and get crazy!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop talking like that, sit back in your chair, and get to work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am not doing anything! (Gets mad and throws his school bag away) I don't respect you and I'm out of control!
